live.detail: BB_M30_LIVE_KEYS=1 + --live not set; live provider validation not exercised (mock coverage only). This is recorded, not hidden.

limitations: Live provider tests run only when BB_M30_LIVE_KEYS=1, --live is passed, and provider keys are in env; without them this suite covers mock paths only and records live: blocked.
Live-call budget is 1 request per provider per run; free-tier rate limits are respected and 429 soft-pass is accepted as a valid outcome.
Network-error mapping is tested against a closed local port, not real internet failures.
